header.account: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm

scorecard.key_number: 1 lead action counts every conversion per click
scorecard.why: An imported 'Phone Call' action counts MANY_PER_CLICK, and three call actions are counted side by side, so call leads can be counted more than once.
Only 22% of spend shows up as search terms. The two terms over target CPA with no conversions are core services, so they go on a watch list, not a negative list.
Out-of-State DUI and Pharmacy Board may overlap the goals of larger campaigns (Nursing Board, DUI); check whether to consolidate. No brand terms leak into non-brand campaigns.
Only 4% of keyword spend sits on QS 1-4. Expected CTR is below average on 12 of the top 20 keywords. 146 live keywords had no impressions (information only).

scorecard.key_number: 58% of rated RSAs are POOR or AVERAGE
scorecard.why: No structured snippet on Drug Charges, Pharmacy Board, Nursing Board, Criminal Defense; Nursing Board has fewer than 4 sitelinks. Every ad group has a responsive search ad and no ad is disapproved.

scorecard.key_number: 43% lost to budget on the best campaign
scorecard.why: Criminal Defense and Traffic Tickets beat target CPA but lose share to budget; DUI loses 64% to rank; 5 Smart Bidding campaigns had under 30 conversions.
Display network off, search partners off, location set to people in the area.
No bid or budget churn in the last 14 days. 57 Google recommendations are open, mostly opt-ins that raise spend; treated as information only.

top_5_fixes.estimate: 55 conversions x 43% lost to budget / 27% impression share, at the current $21 CPA. Upper bound; CPA will rise as budget grows.
top_5_fixes.evidence: campaign query: impression share 27%, lost to budget 43%, CPA $21 vs $30 target
top_5_fixes.who: do this in Google Ads (budget changes are out of scope for this skill)

top_5_fixes.fix: Fix call conversion counting before trusting any bid change
top_5_fixes.money_at_stake: steers ~$5270 a month of conversion-based bidding
top_5_fixes.estimate: Smart Bidding optimises toward counted conversions, so double-counted calls send budget to the wrong places.
top_5_fixes.evidence: conversion_action query: 'Phone Call' (imported clicks, CONTACT) counts MANY_PER_CLICK; 'Calls from ads', 'Phone Call' and 'Call or Text' are all counted
top_5_fixes.who: do this in Google Ads: set lead actions to one per click and keep one primary call action

top_5_fixes.fix: Stop feeding Drug Charges until its CPA is fixed
top_5_fixes.estimate: It loses share to budget, but more budget at this CPA buys expensive leads.
top_5_fixes.evidence: campaign query: 5 conversions on $850, lost to budget 26%
